title: Additive gate-evidence reuse contract (non-authoritative protocol schemas)

producer.review: independent release review APPROVE_MERGE on head 89b339c56a554cd079a7e27ea799c20fa62db896 (zero P0/P1/P2; six D8-v1 schemas byte-identical incl. git blob-OID proof; 12 test vectors passed plus 30 adversarial probes all rejected)
producer.merge: PR #9 merge commit 86aa29af8962c26b133341a9567556b33bac87c0, conduvera/merge-ready check run 113303809271, decision mutdec_1a11b6c802f

acceptance.additivity: This release ADDS two schemas beside the frozen D8_GATE_PROTOCOL set; it changes no D8 v1 bytes, keys, or semantics. GateExecutionKey v1 identity is untouched; reuse is a separate evidence kind, never a re-labelled executed receipt.
acceptance.reuse_doc: gate-evidence-reuse.v1 binds source_execution_key (v1 reference), source_receipt_ref (store_object_id + digest_sha256 + rehashed=true from protected storage), complete_relevant_input_identity (gate, tools, config, locks, environment, dependencies, assurance_class, binding_mode, inputs), current_candidate_binding (tree_sha + plan_id) and an authenticated admission_decision; status is exactly REUSED (never EXECUTED — EXECUTED remains the v1 receipt's own status).
acceptance.reference_v2: gate-evidence-reference.v2 extends the v1 reference with mode EXECUTED|REUSED and validates source-receipt reference and consumer context as SEPARATE sub-schemas; cross-mode pairings are invalid by test vectors.
acceptance.immutability_note: Terminal result reference sets of executed receipts are immutable at the core service level (RESULT_REFS_IMMUTABLE, conduvera-core b7103068) — reuse admission never mutates the source.

protocol_tests.fixtures: inline vectors (12 positive/negative; validation mode reported by the suite)
protocol_tests.rule: all negatives fail closed for their declared reason; cross-mode pairings rejected

cross_repo_handoff.binding_rule: consumers bind this release by exact repository commit and artifact digest, never by a moving branch; the core contract pin moves only in the same change that consumes it
